risks.reasoning: The latest comparable formal cash-flow period is the five months ended 31 August 2020. The accountants' report shows net cash used in operating activities of HK$375 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at period end of HK$8.321 million. Monthly operating cash burn is therefore HK$75 thousand (375/5) and cash runway is approximately 110.95 months (8,321/75), well above the frozen medium trigger of less than 12 months. The risk is therefore rejected.

The accountants' report records profits, not losses, for all three audited annual periods and for both five-month comparative periods. There are zero comparable loss periods, so neither the two-period medium trigger nor the three-period high trigger is met.

Comparable revenue growth is positive throughout the formal accountants' report: approximately +60.33% from FY2017/18 to FY2018/19, +48.33% from FY2018/19 to FY2019/20, and +195.30% for the five months ended 31 August 2020 versus the same five-month period in 2019. No comparable period has negative growth, so neither the medium (<0%) nor high (<=-20%) trigger is met.

For the latest comparable period, the five months ended 31 August 2020, the formal Business table reports largest-customer revenue of HK$83.768 million, top-five customer revenue of HK$210.794 million and total revenue of HK$221.235 million. Ratios calculated from those authoritative table amounts are approximately 37.86% and 95.28%, respectively; the prospectus separately discloses 37.9% and 95.2%, with the minor top-five difference attributable to the table amounts being presented in HK$ thousands. The frozen high threshold is met because top-five concentration is at least 80%.

For the latest comparable period, the five months ended 31 August 2020, the formal Business table reports largest-supplier purchases of HK$47.140 million, top-five supplier purchases of HK$95.647 million and total purchases excluding subcontracting fees of HK$119.271 million. Ratios calculated from those authoritative table amounts are approximately 39.52% and 80.19%, consistent with the prospectus-disclosed 39.5% and 80.2%. The frozen high threshold is met because top-five supplier concentration is at least 80%.

NO_ACTUAL_SPECIAL_RIGHTS: A full-prospectus review identified no pre-IPO investor agreement, shareholder agreement, redemption right, restoration clause, veto right or other effective/restorable special investor right. The disclosed reorganisation and corporate structure involve the founders and group entities, and the prospectus states that there were no outstanding options, warrants or convertible bonds other than disclosed items. Generic Articles/Cayman-law provisions permitting redeemable shares are boilerplate corporate powers and are not treated as actual investor rights under the Protocol.

MATERIALITY_UNRESOLVED: Six workplace accidents remained capable of giving rise to employee-compensation and/or personal-injury litigation, and the legal adviser stated that the potential impact could not then be assessed because proceedings had not commenced. The directors state that insurance should cover the claims, that the accidents caused no material business disruption, and that they had no adverse effect on licences/registrations/permits; the prospectus also states there was no material or systemic non-compliance. Because the possible claims are unresolved and their impact/materiality cannot be assessed, the frozen policy requires needs_review with provisional medium severity rather than a forced verified/rejected conclusion.

The issuer is an established Hong Kong foundation-works contractor that commenced business in 1995 and earned substantial revenue from commercial foundation services throughout the track-record period. Its core offering is already commercialized service activity, not a non-commercialized core product without product-sales revenue. The prospectus also states that the group did not conduct R&D during the track-record period.
